title: 4-bit Shift Register
statement_md: Create a module named `shift_reg4`. It has `clk`, synchronous active-high `reset`, serial input `serial_in`, and a 4-bit output `q`. On every rising edge, if reset is 1, q becomes 0000. Otherwise shift toward the MSB: q[3] gets q[2], q[2] gets q[1], q[1] gets q[0], and q[0] gets serial_in.

tests.hint: reset=1 at a rising edge must clear q to 0000.
The new bit enters at q[0]; check the intended next state is {q[2:0], serial_in}.
Shift several bits in a row and confirm the running pattern matches, not just the first shift.
Shifting a 0 in should push existing bits toward the MSB and drop the oldest bit.
After enough shifts, no original bit should remain — verify the earliest bit actually leaves at q[3].
Toggling reset between clock edges must not change q until the next rising edge.
